summary: Short level kerb of parked cars beside campus lawn; no homes.
reasons: Backs onto lawn and car park

drivers.seclusion: Lawn, courts and a car park on this side; only university buildings 24 m or more away, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed kerb with cars parked in line; level, 13 m long, a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Campus road bending into a junction; steady daytime traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars line this kerb; a van would blend in.

flags: Close to the junction at the south-east end
Low-lying: about 6 m elevation, Brisbane River 215 m away
No signs recorded here; metered area nearby Mon-Fri 7am-9pm
sun_shade: Open to sun; a palm and trees to the north give light shade in the morning.

best_section.where: North kerb of Blair Drive at the bend, beside the lawn and courts
